title: • Reviewed and approved delegation of lending limits to the sanctioning arms of the Bank.
columns:
The Committee:
• Reviewed the quality of the loan portfolio to ensure compliance with requirements of the
Central Bank of Kenya Prudential Guidelines.
• Reviewed and approved delegation of lending limits to the sanctioning arms of the Bank.
• Discussed the concentration risk by industry and portfolio segments and ensured an
appropriate balance was maintained.
• Received updates from the Stressed Assets Group and Stressed Assets Risk (previously the
Group Special Assets) Management teams.
